def triangular_number_diff(n, m):
    """Compute the exact difference between two triangular numbers.

    The triangular numbers arise in elementary calculation as the sums of
    consecutive positive integers, and each admits a simple closed form.
    Throughout this specification, T(k) denotes k * (k + 1) // 2. The
    function receives two indices into this sequence: n and m are ints
    with 0 <= m <= n. Given these indices, evaluate the corresponding
    triangular numbers and report the exact integer amount by which the
    first exceeds the second. Return T(n) - T(m) exactly. All
    computation is over the integers, so no rounding or floating-point
    approximation is involved at any point.

    Examples:
    >>> triangular_number_diff(0, 0)
    0
    >>> triangular_number_diff(5, 2)
    12
